chunks: I asked him عليه السلام about the most excellent thing by which the servants draw near to Allah, Mighty and Majestic. He said: “The most excellent thing by which the servants draw near to Allah, Mighty and Majestic, is obedience to Allah, obedience to His Messenger صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم, and obedience to those vested with authority.”
Abu Jaʿfar عليه السلام said: “Love for us is iman, and hatred for us is kufr.”

key_terms.أُولِي الْأَمْرِ: those vested with authority, namely the rightful divinely appointed authorities
key_terms.حُبُّنَا: love for us, referring to the Ahl al-Bayt عليهم السلام
key_terms.رَسُولِهِ: His Messenger صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم
key_terms.طَاعَةُ: obedience and submission to divine authority
key_terms.يَتَقَرَّبُ: draws near in spiritual proximity and devotion

ai.seo_question: What is the best way for servants to draw near to Allah according to this hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith teaches that the highest means of drawing near to Allah, Mighty and Majestic, is obedience to Allah, His Messenger صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم, and أُولِي الْأَمْرِ. It also affirms the theological significance of devotion to the Ahl al-Bayt عليهم السلام, stating that love for them is iman and enmity toward them is kufr.

en.hubeali: Ali Bin Muhammad Bin Isa, from Yunus, from Muhammad Bin Al Fuzayl who said, ‘I asked himasws about the most superior of what the servant can be near to Allahazwj Mighty and Majestic with. Heasws said: ‘The most superior of what the servants can be closer to Allahazwj Mighty and Majestic with is the obedience to Allahazwj, and obedience to Hisazwj Rasoolsaww, and obedience to the Master of the Command (Ul Al-Amr)’.
Abu Ja’farasws said: ‘Love for usasws is the Eman and hatred for usasws is the disbelief’.
en.sarwar: 12. Ali has narrated from Muhammad ibn ‘Isa from Yunus from Muhammad ibn Fudayl who has said that I asked the Imam (a.s.) about such a matter that would take people closer to Allah. The Imam (a.s.) said, “Of the matters that can take people closer to Allah, the Most Holy, the Most High, the best one is to obey Him, His messenger and those who posses Divine authority.”
Imam abu Ja‘far (a.s.) has said, “To love us if faith and to harbor hatred towards us is disbelief.”
